name: mtr
title: MTR
description: WinMTR-style live traceroute with graphs, background monitoring, alerts, route change detection and an HTML report
author: mendyka

commands.name: trace
commands.title: Trace Route
commands.description: Live traceroute with loss and latency per hop, like WinMTR

commands.name: targets
commands.title: Monitored Targets
commands.description: Status, latency history, route and events of the monitored targets

commands.name: monitor
commands.title: Background Monitor
commands.subtitle: MTR
commands.description: Checks all monitored targets in the background, stores the history and notifies about outages and route changes. Enable it via the command's background refresh setting.

preferences.name: checkEvery
preferences.title: Check Every
preferences.description: How often the targets are checked

commands.name: open-report
commands.title: Open MTR Report
commands.description: Opens the HTML report with graphs of all monitored targets in the browser

preferences.name: rounds
preferences.title: Probes per Check
preferences.description: Probe rounds per background check, one per second (routers often rate-limit faster probing)

preferences.name: lossAlert
preferences.title: Loss Alert (%)
preferences.description: Packet loss to the target at which it counts as degraded

preferences.name: latencyAlert
preferences.title: Latency Alert (ms)
preferences.description: Average latency to the target at which it counts as degraded

preferences.name: notifyRouteChange
preferences.title: Alerts
preferences.label: Notify about route changes
preferences.description: Notify when the path to a target changes

preferences.name: notifyRecovery
preferences.label: Notify when a target is OK again
preferences.description: Notify when a target is reachable again

preferences.name: traceInterval
preferences.title: Live Trace Interval (ms)
preferences.description: Time between probe rounds in “Trace Route”

preferences.name: timeout
preferences.title: Timeout (ms)
preferences.description: How long to wait for each reply

preferences.name: packetSize
preferences.title: Packet Size (bytes)
preferences.description: Payload size of each ICMP echo request
